lines.t: Bastian's humming. He only hums when a challenger's properly tempered. Last time was… four years? Five?
Galewick's north gate will open for you now. Gloamstair's up past it. Cold up there. You'll miss this place.
Welcome to the Forge Hall. The magma channels are shut by brass sluices. Out-battle a hall Tuner, and their sluice swings open.
Two Tuners, two sluices. Then Cantor Bastian at the anvil. His kin are fire, and so is the hall. Water and stone fare well.
The lava's railed. Please don't test the rails. People keep testing the rails.
Odile Graven? I knew her father. She was on the Ash Flats that day. Nobody who saw it came back the same.
She's not cruel, that one. She's frightened, and she's clever, and that's a worse mix than cruel.
North gate at Galewick's open for you. Go up the Gloamstair. And take a coat — heat doesn't travel.
Made it past the sluices. Good. Sit a moment, you're steaming.
Heat's honest. It tells you exactly how close is too close.
Tempered. Good steel doesn't shatter, it bends back.
Frost Keynote. Fire teaches you what cold is worth.
And this Etude, straight off the anvil. Hammer it into a kin who doesn't flinch.
Galewick's north gate opens for Tuners who carry my note. The Gloamstair's past it. Mind the quiet up there.
Heat's honest. It tells you exactly how close is too close.
Tempered. Good steel doesn't shatter, it bends back.
Too hot, too fast. Cool off and come back.
Frost Keynote. Fire teaches you what cold is worth.
Odile Graven? I knew her father. She was on the Ash Flats that day. Nobody who saw it came back the same.
